notes: A whole shoot, the RAW folder of Greenwich Park (2025-03-15): 23 exposure brackets of 3 frames 0.1 s apart, six of them stopped after 2 frames, often only 0.6-1.5 s after the previous bracket, between handheld single shots about a second apart. A hard case for time-based stacking. The groups are the sequences the camera recorded. Used by tools/benchmark.lua.
